purpose: Reference emission factors for a carbon footprint calculator scoped to Ernakulam district, Kerala, India. The database intentionally separates district-scoped assumptions from national grid/default factors and does not claim district-specific validity where the source is national or generic.

geographic_scope.scope_note: Ernakulam district is the planning area. National default factors are retained only when the source explicitly states a national or grid-level applicability and are clearly labelled as not district-specific.

factors.activity: purchased electricity consumption from the Indian grid
factors.geographic_applicability: India (national grid, location-based electricity factor); not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.source_organisation: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power, Government of India
factors.source_document: CEA CO2 Baseline Database, Version 22.0, official national grid baseline dataset and methodology.
factors.methodology: Weighted-average national grid CO2 emission factor published by CEA for FY 2025-26. This is the location-based grid factor and not an operating margin, build margin, or combined margin factor. It is not an Ernakulam-specific electricity factor.
factors.assumptions: The value reflects the national grid average applied to purchased electricity from the Indian grid. It does not apply to district-level grid dispatch, captive generation, or contractual renewable electricity claims.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: National grid factor; not site-specific; not applicable to captive generation, rooftop solar, or contractual renewable procurement claims; year-specific review is required for each reporting period.
factors.calculation_basis: Official CEA database value stored directly as 0.675 tCO2/MWh for FY 2025-26. No margin conversion is applied.

factors.geographic_applicability: Generic default fuel combustion factor; not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: IPCC default methodology value; no single fiscal year attached.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy, fuel combustion default factors.
factors.methodology: Generic direct CO2 factor converted from standard fuel-combustion defaults using a typical gasoline density of 0.74 kg/L and net calorific value approximately 43.5 MJ/kg. Resulting factor: approximately 2.31 kg CO2/L. This is a CO2-only factor and excludes CH4 and N2O.
factors.assumptions: Density = 0.74 kg/L (common gasoline assumption). Net calorific value = 43.5 MJ/kg. Carbon factor basis is the standard IPCC fuel-combustion default; no local fuel-specification adjustment or engine-efficiency correction is included.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic fuel factor; actual emissions vary by blend, fuel composition and equipment performance; this value is not a measured or district-specific fuel property.
factors.calculation_basis: Approximate conversion from standard IPCC fuel CO2 default to volume basis using density and net calorific value assumptions; final value rounded to 2.31 kg CO2/L.

factors.geographic_applicability: Generic default fuel combustion factor; not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: IPCC default methodology value; no single fiscal year attached.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy, fuel combustion default factors.
factors.methodology: Generic direct CO2 factor converted from standard fuel-combustion defaults using a typical diesel density of 0.84 kg/L and net calorific value approximately 43.0 MJ/kg. Resulting factor: approximately 2.68 kg CO2/L. This is a CO2-only factor and excludes CH4 and N2O.
factors.assumptions: Density = 0.84 kg/L. Net calorific value = 43.0 MJ/kg. Carbon factor basis follows the standard IPCC combustion default; no local fuel-specification or engine-efficiency adjustment is included.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic fuel factor; actual emissions vary by fuel quality, sulfur content, blend and combustion equipment performance; this value is not a measured or district-specific fuel property.
factors.calculation_basis: Approximate conversion from standard IPCC fuel CO2 default to volume basis using density and net calorific value assumptions; final value rounded to 2.68 kg CO2/L.

factors.geographic_applicability: Generic default fuel combustion factor; not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: IPCC default methodology value; no single fiscal year attached.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy, fuel combustion default factors.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 default: 63,100 kg CO2/TJ for LPG. Net calorific value: 47.3 TJ/Gg = 47.3 MJ/kg. Calculation: 63,100 × 47.3 × 10^-6 = 2.98463 kg CO2/kg LPG. Rounded value: 2.98 kg CO2/kg LPG. This is a CO2-only factor and excludes CH4 and N2O.
factors.assumptions: Net calorific value for LPG = 47.3 MJ/kg. Carbon factor = 63,100 kg CO2/TJ. No appliance-specific efficiency factors or local fuel-grade correction are included.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic fuel factor; actual emissions vary by LPG composition and equipment; not a measured or district-specific fuel property. CH4 and N2O are excluded, so this is not full CO2e accounting.

factors.activity: direct combustion of diesel in industrial boilers, generators and stationary equipment
factors.geographic_applicability: Generic default fuel combustion factor; not facility-specific and not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: IPCC default methodology value; no single fiscal year attached.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy, fuel combustion default factors.
factors.methodology: Generic direct CO2 factor converted from standard fuel-combustion defaults for diesel using a typical density of 0.84 kg/L and net calorific value of 43.0 MJ/kg. This is a CO2-only factor and excludes CH4 and N2O.
factors.assumptions: Applies to diesel consumed directly in stationary industrial combustion; no process-specific technology adjustment; no capture or abatement assumptions.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic combustion factor; not a measured stack-emission factor; it does not cover electricity consumed or upstream fuel production emissions.
factors.calculation_basis: Same IPCC default conversion basis as the general diesel factor: approximately 2.68 kg CO2/L using the standard volume-to-mass conversion assumptions.

factors.activity: direct combustion of LPG in industrial and process heating equipment
factors.geographic_applicability: Generic default fuel combustion factor; not facility-specific and not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: IPCC default methodology value; no single fiscal year attached.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy, fuel combustion default factors.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 factor for LPG combustion in stationary industrial use using the official LPG default of 63,100 kg CO2/TJ and a net calorific value of 47.3 MJ/kg. This is a CO2-only factor and excludes CH4 and N2O.
factors.assumptions: Applies to LPG consumed directly in combustion equipment; no process-specific or burner-efficiency adjustment.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic combustion factor; not a measured stack-emission factor; not representative of all industrial combustion technologies or fuel blends.
